arguments.query: SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL)) deliv, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id=o.order_id)) shp, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=o.order_id)) pay, sum(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)) ref FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status
SELECT payment_status,count(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, sum(s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL) d FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
SELECT o.status, count(*) n, sum(p.payment_status='ok') ok FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
